problem: Production pricing had valid i18n assets but no visible mobile language selector, so the exact-main browser proof failed after opening the mobile navigation.
root_cause: tools/site-shell/apply-i18n.mjs treated an existing data-bg-i18n-asset marker as a reason to return from the whole page patch. Pages that already carried the CSS/runtime therefore skipped the separate idempotent mobile-control injection.
prevention: Asset injection and mobile-control injection are separate idempotent responsibilities and must never share an early-return guard.
Pages with pre-existing i18n assets must still be evaluated for missing mobile language controls.
Production browser proof must open the real mobile drawer and require a visible native language select before NL to EN to NL routing is accepted.

evidence.error: visible mobile language select is missing after opening mobile navigation
